standards.name: AnaEE Thesaurus (ANAEETHES)
standards.abstract: The AnaEE Thesaurus (ANAEETHES) is a SKOS-based controlled vocabulary / thesaurus intended to describe studies of continental ecosystems and their biodiversity. It is published/hosted in AgroPortal and maintained by the AnaEE semantics group (CNRS, INRAE). The resource is provided as an ontology (RDF/SKOS) with web-resolvable representations and portal metadata (e.g. last submission date). The thesaurus supplies concepts, properties, schemes and collections that can be accessed via AgroPortal, with SPARQL and widget support for reuse and mappings to other resources.

classification.rationale: The source material is an ontology/thesaurus presented as a set of interlinked components (concepts, properties, schemes/collections, mappings, SPARQL entry point). This is best modelled as a graph (nodes and relationships) rather than a field-level metadata table or a set of reporting instructions, so 'dag' (concept graph) matches the source structure.
